content: {"praised":["Great script and strong performances by Widmark and Horn.","Good plot with engaging characters and clear story.","Beautiful scenery enhances the Western atmosphere.","Family-friendly tone suitable for Saturday afternoon viewing.","Widmark’s acting praised as superb in this Western."],"criticized":["Sound quality poor, dialogue difficult to understand.","Color palette like finger paints, unrealistic blood.","Makeup appeared pock-marked on many characters.","Script had many dangling, fill-in-the-blanks moments.","No captioning, making accessibility an issue."]}
